definition: Stable identifier and primary key of one curated association row; join key to its operation guards and any scoped exposure qualifier.
Source anchor identifying the original table, worksheet and cells, or publication-table row and contrast; preserve the reported anchor without inventing absent cell details.
Review slots contributing source records; their identity does not mean every final field was independently supplied by both reviewers.

Review metadata date rather than publication or exposure date; round-specific provenance is preserved and the five separately reviewed second-round rows use the later of the two original review dates.
Coordinator-issued exposure-concept key, not a chemical identity or automatically transferable vocabulary/CAS key.
Curated display label for the exposure concept; the label alone does not specify analyte species, exposure medium or measurement equivalence.
Source-reported array probe identifier; retain ch.6.19775382R without relabeling and exclude it from CpG-only matching.
Sign of the reported association
Effect estimate exactly as reported by the source
Type of estimator or coefficient represented by the source effect estimate, such as a regression coefficient; the label does not establish common units or model compatibility across sources.
Standard error as reported; not_reported where the source reports none

Source-reported p-value; preserve numeric text and tiny positive values. Stored source zeros have unknown exact precision and no assigned bound; do not guess replacements or treat them as exact probabilities.
Curated label for the biological tissue assayed by the source; tissue labels do not establish comparable cell composition, sample independence or model suitability.
Curated label for the source methylation assay platform; use the pinned manifest for that declared platform and never assume an unknown platform is 450K.
Analytic sample size for this association as reported
Curated source-study/cohort label, not an independence assessment. First-round and second-round provenance differ; the five second-round IDs are coordinator-issued.
PubMed identifier of the source publication
Description of whether the source results cover a complete tested set or a selected or thresholded subset; an absent probe is not a null result and a selected list is not a tested-probe universe.
Admission outcome under the uniform rule applied to a pre-screened active set; include describes the current admitted row rather than the full discovery or screening universe.
not_applicable for the included rows in this candidate; this does not mean no records were excluded or suspended outside the candidate.

Tagged source-review notes preserving scientific qualifications. In this reader copy, the internal mapping filename and abbreviated checksum are replaced by a self-contained mapping description; coordinator-letter references are clarified and retrieval wording does not imply a publisher reuse grant. Coordinator notes remain separate.

Measurement or exposure-context medium represented by the source association, retained as coordinator-derived metadata. For PMID34717175 the 2,717 PM2.5 total-mass rows use ambient air; the 7,043 component rows retain their component designation. Medium labels do not establish chemical identity or measurement equivalence.

Source-specific averaging period or lag window represented by the association, retained as coordinator-derived metadata; the five second-round rows use 2- or 7-day trailing windows. Different windows are not interchangeable.

Source outcome scale, such as percent 5-mC, beta value or M-value, retained as coordinator-derived metadata; effect estimates on different scales are not interchangeable without a justified transformation.

Source exposure increment, category comparison or contrast represented by the coefficient, retained as coordinator-derived metadata; combine its interpretation with effect_estimate_type and methylation_scale rather than assuming a common increment.
Coordinator adjudication note; kept separate from the curator-submitted notes column

Primary key of this exposure-concept crosswalk; joins many association rows through evidence.toxicant_id. The association table primary key is evidence_id; this key is not interchangeable with vocabulary_entity_id.
Separate vocabulary entity or particle-fraction key associated with the exposure concept
Preferred vocabulary label; not the original study exposure label
Kind of linked vocabulary entity
Association semantics; never a declaration that the keys or measurements are equivalent
Number of first-round curated evidence rows using this exposure key
Number of the separately reviewed second-round associations using this exposure key in the combined candidate; this count does not imply that historical first-round files were rewritten.
Vocabulary assertion status; pending CAS assertions remain unverified

Whether external Chemical Abstracts Service (CAS) or Chemical Entities of Biological Interest (ChEBI) identifiers may be copied to the exposure-concept key; false for all current concepts because the links do not verify external chemical identity.
Workflow status recording an accepted exposure-to-vocabulary association without authorization for public evidence release; this status is not an artifact-specific reuse license.
Primary key joining one curated evidence row; definitions must not be joined by exposure ID alone
Exposure-concept key matching the joined curated evidence row
Source PubMed identifier matching the joined evidence row

Study-specific urinary arsenic definition: total_arsenic_gfaas denotes source-reported total arsenic measured by graphite furnace atomic absorption spectrometry; sum_iAs_MMA_DMA denotes the sum of inorganic arsenic and its mono- and dimethylated metabolites measured by high-performance liquid chromatography coupled to inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry excluding arsenobetaine; not_applicable is used only for the coarse-PM rows

Operational measurement or derivation note; coarse particulate matter (PM) is modeled PM10 minus modeled PM2.5, not direct sampling. Absence of a qualifier row means outside this limited 109-row scope, not missing evidence or verified absence of additional qualifications.
Source anchor matching the joined curated evidence row
Stable key joining exactly one curated evidence row.
Publication identifier matching the joined evidence row.
Unmodified source probe identifier, including non-cg labels.
Platform label matching the curated source row.
Declared platform group; unknown is never defaulted to 450K.
Lookup outcome under the declared platform and cg-form rule; not biological validation.
Reason a CpG-only lookup failed; an empty string means no failure reason.
Pinned manifest identifier; no annotation redistribution authorization.
Version of the manifest used for the lookup.
Necessary lookup prerequisite only; false for non-cg labels even when the label exists in a manifest.
Exact reported numeric text or controlled missing code; parse with precision-preserving arithmetic.
Source representation; stored zeros have unknown precision, not exact zero probabilities.
Positive reported p-value prerequisite only; false for source zeros and missing values.
Unmodified reported standard-error text; missing values are not imputed.
Positive reported standard-error prerequisite only; not pooling eligibility or authorization.
Semicolon-separated operation limitations; empty means no listed failure, not permission to analyze.
